clue.text: Support section of the orchestra that is backing the Queen

clue.text: Blue wife died in parking space

explanation.definitionFit: To absolve someone is to free them formally from guilt or blame, as a priest or court might forgive.

clue.text: Start to scrub grease stain

blocks.note: opening letter of scrub
oil is a greasy substance

explanation.walkthrough: 'Grease stain' reads as one thing to be scrubbed; 'stain' is the definition on its own.
explanation.definitionFit: To soil something is to make it dirty or mark it, a verb meaning to stain.

clue.text: Heads of education department guarantee exam advantage

blocks.note: opening letters of these four words

blocks.note: an ex is a former partner
pliable means easily bent, flexible
opening letter of contact

explanation.surface: An ex who is easygoing about keeping in touch is someone you can understand.
explanation.walkthrough: EX + PLI(C)ABLE gives EXPLICABLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something explicable can be explained or accounted for, so it is capable of being understood.

clue.text: Domestic animals eating small bugs

blocks.note: taken as written

clue.text: Cleaner bizarrely dug his in-law quip

clue.text: Cook loyally holds back part of egg

explanation.definitionFit: The yolk is the yellow centre of an egg, surrounded by the white.

clue.text: Wasted young lady to hedge bet finally

blocks.note: a miss is a girl or young woman
to pen in is to enclose or hedge in
last letter of bet

clue.text: Blog entries about unpleasant odour old upper class produces after death

clue.text: Wonders of flower returned by gutted pharaoh

returned means sent back, so the flower is read from end to start

blocks.note: outer letters of pharaoh

explanation.walkthrough: PH + ENOMENA (ANEMONE reversed) gives PHENOMENA.
explanation.definitionFit: Phenomena are remarkable things or people, so the plural can mean marvels or prodigies.

clue.text: Bedevilled groups spend oddly

first, third and fifth letters of spend

clue.text: Track broadcast on the radio

clue.text: Awkward English test I have
